papers.title: A short proof of Serre positivity
papers.abstract: Recently, OpenAI found a proof of the positivity of Serre's intersection multiplicity. The two main ingredients are a descent result on rational $K$-theory with support; and a construction of certain category of asymptotic complexes that identifies with the category of perfect complexes over a connective (non-commutative) derived ring. In this article, we present a simpler proof of Serre positivity that circumvents the second step; instead, we use a ``reduction to the diagonal" trick via the $A_{\text{inf}}$-construction.

papers.title: An equivariant index theorem for the Heisenberg calculus
papers.abstract: We derive a local fixed-point formula for the equivariant index of Heisenberg elliptic operators on closed contact manifolds equipped with an action of a compact Lie group preserving the contact form. The formula expresses the character of the equivariant index in terms of a cyclic-cohomological character of the noncommutative Heisenberg principal symbol. The main new ingredient is the construction of traces, one on each fixed-point set, defined by integration over twisted conjugacy classes in the Heisenberg group. The proof proceeds by a K-theoretic reduction to the equivariant index theorem of our paper "Toeplitz operators on contact manifolds and equivariant K-homology".

papers.title: Koszul duality in exact categories
papers.abstract: In this paper we establish Koszul duality-type results in the setting of chain complexes in exact categories. In particular, we prove generalisations of Vallette's Koszul duality theorem and Koszul duality along the lines of Lurie and Pridham. We also prove a connective version. We conclude with some applications. These include our main example, the category of complete bornological spaces over a Banach field, as well as a sketch of deformation theory in formal geometry.

papers.title: A full-rank subgroup of Bloch Groups of CM Fields
papers.abstract: This article generalizes the result of Burns et al (2022), to find an algorithm to find some elements generating a full-rank subgroup of the torsion-free part of Bloch group of a certain CM number field, and compute the rank of it.
